label: Town of Belvidere
header:
# Town of Belvidere municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 2; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists three Belvidere Selectboard members: Kenneth Adams, Jr., Earl Domina, Jr. (Chair), and Kevin Leavitt.
Town of Belvidere official website, Select Board page: lists Earl Domina, Jr. (Chair), Ken Adams, Jr., and Kevin Leavitt.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Cathy Mander-Adams as Town Clerk of Belvidere.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact information spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Cathy Mander-Adams as Town Clerk of Belvidere.
Town of Belvidere official website, homepage 'Elected Town Positions' listing: lists 'Town Clerk & Treasurer / Cathy Mander-Adams' among the town's elected positions.
Town of Belvidere, Town Meeting minutes, March 3, 2026: record Cathy Mander-Adams elected Town Clerk by voice vote.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Cathy Mander-Adams as Town Treasurer of Belvidere.
Town of Belvidere official website, homepage 'Elected Town Positions' listing: lists 'Town Clerk & Treasurer / Cathy Mander-Adams' among the town's elected positions.

Town of Belvidere, Town Meeting minutes, March 3, 2026: record Cathy Mander-Adams elected Town Treasurer by voice vote. The Secretary of State's treasurer contact spreadsheet prints no Belvidere treasurer ('Contact Town Clerk for more information').
Town of Belvidere official website, homepage 'Elected Town Positions' listing: lists 'Moderator / Pamela McKenna' among the town's elected positions.
Town of Belvidere official website, Listers and Appraisals page: lists Stacey Chase, Stephanie Domina, and Richard Schoon as the town's listers.
Town of Belvidere official website, homepage 'Elected Town Positions' listing: lists 'Auditors / William McLean; Gary Edmonds; Pamela McKenna' among the town's elected positions.
Town of Belvidere official website, homepage 'Elected Town Positions' listing: lists 'Road Commissioner / Kevin Leavitt' among the town's elected positions.
Town of Belvidere official website, homepage 'Elected Town Positions' listing: lists 'Collector of Delinquent Taxes / Mary Hysick' among the town's elected positions (17 V.S.A. section 2651d).
Town of Belvidere official website, homepage 'Elected Town Positions' listing: lists 'First Constable / Stacey Chase' among the town's elected positions.
Town of Belvidere official website, homepage 'Elected Town Positions' listing: lists 'Second Constable / Stephen Brown' among the town's elected positions.
17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a grand juror at annual town meeting.
Town of Belvidere official website, homepage 'Elected Town Positions' listing: does not list a grand juror, and no other official source publishes the holder.
17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a town agent to prosecute and defend suits at annual town meeting.
Town of Belvidere official website, homepage 'Elected Town Positions' listing: does not list a town agent, and no other official source publishes the holder.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Belvidere justices of the peace. The town website's own justice listing names three of them with variant forms ('Andy Iwaskiewicz', 'Stephanie Draper', 'Thad Tallman'); the Secretary of State's listing governs, and its 'Stephanie Domina' is the town lister of that name (the town site's 'Draper' is her other surname).

jp_election.name: Town of Belvidere Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Belvidere justices of the peace for the 2025-2026 term (Cathy Mander-Adams, Stephanie Domina, Thad Tallman, Stephen Brown, Andrew Iwaskiewicz); they are the winners of the November 5, 2024 election for the office. The listing publishes no vote totals and no party designations for justices of the peace.
